description: Master Django's powerful admin interface configuration and customization

slides.title: Introduction to Django Admin
slides.content:
# Django Admin 🛠️

A powerful, auto-generated admin interface for managing your data!

## What you'll learn:
- **Configuring the admin panel** - Setup and registration
- **Customizing admin interface** - Fields, filters, search

## Why Django Admin?

- 🚀 **Instant CRUD** - No code needed
- 🔐 **Secure** - Permission-based access
- 📊 **Rich features** - Filtering, search, export
- 🎨 **Customizable** - Make it your own

## Quick Start

```bash
# Create a superuser to access admin
python manage.py createsuperuser

# Run server
python manage.py runserver

# Visit: http://127.0.0.1:8000/admin/
```

## URL Configuration (Already included!)

```python
# urls.py
from django.contrib import admin
from django.urls import path

urlpatterns = [
    path('admin/', admin.site.urls),  # Admin at /admin/
]
```

> 💡 **Fun Fact:** The Django admin was originally created to allow newspaper editors to manage content quickly!

slides.title: Configuring Admin Panel
slides.content:
# Registering Models 📋

## Basic Registration

```python
# blog/admin.py
from django.contrib import admin
from .models import Article, Category, Tag

# Simplest form - just register
admin.site.register(Article)
admin.site.register(Category)
admin.site.register(Tag)
```

## ModelAdmin Class

```python
# blog/admin.py
from django.contrib import admin
from .models import Article

@admin.register(Article)  # Decorator syntax
class ArticleAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    # Display these columns in the list view
    list_display = ['title', 'author', 'category', 'status', 'published']
    
    # Add filters in the sidebar
    list_filter = ['status', 'category', 'published']
    
    # Search these fields
    search_fields = ['title', 'content', 'author__username']
    
    # Date-based navigation
    date_hierarchy = 'published'
    
    # Default ordering
    ordering = ['-published']
```

## Alternative Registration

```python
# Without decorator
class ArticleAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ['title', 'author']

admin.site.register(Article, ArticleAdmin)
```

> 💡 **`list_display`** shows columns in the list view - essential for usability!

slides.title: More Customizations
Summary
slides.content:
# Excellent Work! 🎉

You've mastered Django Admin!

## Configuring the Admin Panel
- ✅ `admin.site.register(Model)`
- ✅ Create superuser with `createsuperuser`
- ✅ Access at `/admin/`

## Customizing Admin Interface
- ✅ **list_display** - Columns in list view
- ✅ **list_filter** - Sidebar filters
- ✅ **search_fields** - Search bar
- ✅ **list_editable** - Edit in list view
- ✅ **fieldsets** - Organize edit form
- ✅ **inlines** - Edit related objects
- ✅ **actions** - Bulk operations
- ✅ **prepopulated_fields** - Auto-generate slugs
- ✅ Custom display functions

## Quick Reference

```python
@admin.register(Article)
class ArticleAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ['title', 'status', 'published']
    list_filter = ['status', 'category']
    search_fields = ['title', 'content']
    prepopulated_fields = {'slug': ('title',)}
    date_hierarchy = 'published'
    ordering = ['-published']
```

> 🚀 **Next Steps:** Learn about Django REST Framework!
